My First Day at University: 大学第一天:迷路、英文自我介绍、加入摄影社,比预期更精彩。

My first day at university was exciting and a little scary. The campus was much bigger than my high school, and I got lost twice before I found the lecture hall. Luckily, a friendly senior student helped me and showed me the way.

In the English class, the teacher asked us to introduce ourselves in English. I was nervous at first, but after a few sentences I began to feel more comfortable. Some classmates even laughed at my jokes!

After class, I joined the photography club. There are about thirty members, and they meet every Friday afternoon. I also got my student card and borrowed three books from the library. When I called my parents that evening, I told them that university life was better than I had expected.
